title: Appointment of a guardian ad litem.
bodyText: The family court, upon receipt of a petition filed under this part, shall determine the existence of a guardian and if none, shall appoint a guardian ad litem to represent the best interests of the subject of the petition throughout the pendency of the proceedings.
bodyHtml: [§334-123.5]  Appointment of a guardian ad litem.  The family court, upon receipt of a petition filed under this part, shall determine the existence of a guardian and if none, shall appoint a guardian ad litem to represent the best interests of the subject of the petition throughout the pendency of the proceedings. [L 2021, c 58, §2]
